name: Simeon
overview: Simeon, whose name means 'Hearing,' is introduced as a son of Jacob, born to Leah (Genesis 29:33). He is notably involved with his brother Levi in avenging the defilement of their sister Dinah, an act that caused Jacob great distress and fear for his family's safety among the Canaanites (Genesis 34:30). Later, Simeon is detained by Joseph in Egypt as a hostage to ensure his brothers' return with their youngest sibling, Benjamin, which deeply grieves Jacob (Genesis 42:24, 36; 43:23). These passages highlight Simeon's role within the family dynamics of Jacob's household and God's providential plan in preserving the lineage through trials.
